signIn.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

pair.title: Just the two of you
pair.subtitle: One of you starts, the other joins with the code.
pair.shareHint: Share this with your partner. It stops working once they join.
pair.waiting: Waiting for your partner to join.
pair.partnerJoinedHint: Both phones can read everything the two of you write from here on.
pair.partnerAwayHint: It was here a moment ago. Open the app on their phone and it will appear again. The invite code has already been used, so it won't work a second time.

error.invalid_code: That code doesn't match. Check it and try again.
error.couple_full: That code belongs to a pair that is already complete.
error.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.unknown: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

name.title: Your name
name.description: How your partner sees you. Sealed on this device like everything else — only the two of you can read it.
name.label: Your name

unlock.title: One more step
unlock.subtitle: This device doesn't have the key to your shared history yet.
unlock.hint: Open this app on the device that already works, go to Settings, and approve this one. Check that the code below is the one it shows you.
unlock.noPartnerYet: No other device has appeared yet.
unlock.mismatchHelp: Nothing has been shared yet, so there's nothing to undo. Get a new code below and compare again. If it still doesn't match, stop — someone may be sitting between the two of you.
unlock.reset: Get a new code for this device

recovery.title: Ways back in
recovery.subtitle: Try these in order. The first one loses nothing.

partner.title: Ask your partner
partner.body: If they can still open the app on their phone, they can let this device in from Settings. This is the way that keeps everything.

code.title: Use your recovery code
code.body: The twenty-five characters you wrote down when you saved a code. Capitals, lower case and hyphens all work.
code.label: Recovery code

error.no_envelope: There's no recovery code saved for this account. If your partner can still open the app, ask them to let this device in.
error.bad_code: That code didn't open it. Check it and try again.

startOver.title: Start over
startOver.body: If neither of you can get in and there's no code, everything the two of you wrote is gone. Nobody can read it — not your partner, not us. Starting over disconnects you and deletes it, and you begin again from a new invite.
startOver.bothMust: Your partner has to do this on their phone too. Until they do, they stay connected to a history neither of you can read.

save.title: Recovery code
save.body: A code you write down and keep somewhere safe. It's the only way back in if neither phone can open the app.
save.replace: Replace it with a new one
save.writeItDown: Write this down now, somewhere that isn't a phone.
save.onlyOnce: This is the only time it will be shown. It can't be looked up again — that's what makes it safe to store.

devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Every phone and app signed in to the two of you.
devices.withdrawHint: You can only remove your own devices, and removing one doesn't take back a key it already has — that lives on the device itself. To put a device beyond reach, sign out on it or delete the app.

approve.title: Let a device in
approve.subtitle: Approving gives it access to everything the two of you have written.
approve.compare: Both screens should show these same characters. Read them aloud to each other.
approve.action: The codes match — let it in
approve.mismatch: If the codes are different, don't approve — use the button above instead.
approve.mismatchHelp: Nothing was shared, and nothing needs undoing. On the other device, choose "the codes don't match" and then "get a new code", and compare again.

error.key_changed: That device changed while you were comparing. Start again and check the new code.
error.gone: That device is no longer waiting.

connected.title: Us and Two22
connected.summary: Both apps are yours and your partner's, and they use the same account. You only connect once.

shared.account: Your sign-in, so you never sign in twice.
shared.pairing: Your connection to each other, and their name.
shared.timezone: The time zone your dates are counted in.

connected.separateTitle: Kept to the app you wrote it in

separate.language: Your language, which is yours alone — your partner reads in theirs.

unpair.title: Unpair
unpair.summary: This disconnects you from your partner. Your plans stay on their device, and the invite code they hold stops working.
